text.en: A does a job in 12 days and B in 6. Call the job 12 units: then A does 1 a day and B does 2.

learned.en: A job is a fixed amount of person-days.
$M_1 D_1 = M_2 D_2$: more people, fewer days.
learned.as: $M_1 D_1 = M_2 D_2$: বেছি মানুহ, কম দিন।

learned.en: Hours count too: $M_1 D_1 H_1 = M_2 D_2 H_2$.
learned.as: ঘণ্টাও গণা হয়: $M_1 D_1 H_1 = M_2 D_2 H_2$।

learned.en: Time is the opposite ratio of efficiency.

text.en: 16 people need 15 days: 240 person-days. Width is people, height is days, and the area never changes.
text.as: 16 জনক 15 দিন লাগে: 240 মানুহ-দিন। প্ৰস্থ মানুহ, উচ্চতা দিন, কালি সলনি নহয়।

then.en: The rectangle gets wider and shorter: 10 days. 24 × 10 is still 240.
then.as: আয়ত বহল আৰু চুটি হয়: 10 দিন। 24 × 10 এতিয়াও 240।

then.en: Half the people, twice the days: 30.

text.en: If A works twice as fast as B, A needs half the days.
text.as: A Bতকৈ দুগুণ সোনকালে কৰিলে Aক আধা দিন লাগে।

text.en: Efficiency 2 : 1 means time 1 : 2, and together they are 3 units a day.
text.as: দক্ষতা 2 : 1 মানে সময় 1 : 2, একেলগে দিনে 3 একক।

q.en: A works 2 times as fast as B. B alone takes 30 days. How long do they take together?

why.en: B does 1 part a day and A does 2: 3 parts together, so 30 ÷ 3.
why.as: Bই দিনে 1 ভাগ, Aই 2: একেলগে 3, সেয়ে 30 ÷ 3।

why.en: That is A alone. Together adds B's rate as well.
why.as: সেয়া A অকলে। একেলগে Bৰ হাৰো যোগ হয়।
